responsibility: This target header adapts the generic SPARC backend to System V Release 4 conventions. It overrides fundamental ABI type names, assembler and section directives, PIC assembler flags, case-label and symbol-definition output forms, ctor/dtor section declarations, BSS emission, and profiling symbol naming, supplying the SVR4-flavored assembly and object-file conventions on which more specific SPARC OS targets can build.
